prioritiesTomorrow.text: Work Inbox -- render CC Today/This Week tasks as cards in priority panel
prioritiesTomorrow.description: Work Inbox and Command Centre work in tandem. Currently the CC button appears on work-inbox priority cards only when an email has been linked to a CC task by Phase 3.6. The gap: CC Today/This Week tasks that have no current email (e.g. t015 -- originating email is 22 days old, outside the 50-email fetch window) never appear in work-inbox at all. Kevin's workflow: scan Work Inbox first for morning overview, click CC button to go straight into the task. This should work for all active CC tasks, not just ones with a recent email. Card design: two visible tags on the card face -- Email tag (clickable, opens email via openmail:// using entryId, only shown if entryId is set) and CC tag (links to Command Centre task). The email open tag is more naturally at home in Work Inbox than in CC since WI is email-first. Cards visually distinct from inbox email cards -- CC-sourced label so Kevin knows at a glance where they came from. Exclude done tasks and Parked tier.
actions: [25 Jun 2026] Feature scoped by Kevin -- CC Today/This Week tasks should appear in Work Inbox priority panel with CC button. Originating issue: t015 not visible in work-inbox because its email is 22 days old and outside the 50-email fetch window.

[25 Jun 2026] Card design refined -- two tags on card face: Email tag (openmail:// via entryId, shown only if entryId set) and CC tag (links to Command Centre). Email open is more relevant in WI than CC since WI is email-first; both tags should appear in both dashboards but Email tag is the primary action in WI.
